current_difficulty_reason: The minimal moments do not provide uniform ellipticity or the higher integrability usually used to discard bad sets. The source proves weak-L1 convergence of oscillating weights and a diagonal-weight vectorial truncation, then constructs a boundary-layer blow-up lower bound compatible with those moments. Those new ingredients and the simultaneous measurable cell limit remain required after standard ergodic and selection foundations are allowed; the final Gamma-limit assembly is not admitted on its own.
